pages.text: $(thing)Powdery Mildew of Cereals$() ($(o)Blumeria graminis$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() common wheat, durum wheat, barley, oats, rye.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 5-25 °C (best 18 °C), humidity above 70%.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 0.5 years (residue).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 25% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Resistant cultivars; Avoid excessive nitrogen and dense stands; Fungicide.
Unlike most leaf diseases it does not need free water; dry, mild, humid weather favours it.
